goal: Know the others best: guess what each subject answers about themselves.
loop: Each round one player is the subject and answers a question about themselves; everyone else guesses their answer; then the answers are revealed.
actions: Answer about yourself when you are the subject.
private_information: Each answer and guess, until the reveal.
rounds: One round per player, each the subject once.
scoring: A right guess gives 1 point to the guesser and 1 to the subject.
ending: After every player was the subject, the ranking shows who knows whom best.
